collection.title: Lexus RC Series 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Lexus RC Series 2014 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and an 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
